# Love to Spa

> A wellness travel platform offering personalized spa coaching, curated spa directory, and transformational experiences guided by astrology and Human Design.

Love to Spa is founded by Betsy Leahy, an award-winning wellness travel coach who combines spa expertise with astrology and Human Design to create bespoke wellness journeys. The site serves as both a resource hub for spa travelers and a coaching platform for personal transformation through spa and wellness experiences.

## Core Platform

- [Love to Spa Homepage](https://www.lovetospa.com): Love to Spa homepage: spa travel, wellness retreats, and self-care destination.
- [Ask Love to Spa](https://lovetospa.com/ask-love-to-spa): AI-powered personalized spa guide using astrology and Human Design to match travelers with ideal spa experiences.
- [Little Pink Book of Spas](https://lovetospa.com/spas): Curated spa directory by wellness expert Betsy Leahy featuring vetted luxury spas and wellness retreats worldwide.

## Coaching & Programs

- [Offerings](https://www.lovetospa.com/offerings): Love to Spa offerings: spa coaching, wellness experiences, and digital programs for personal transformation.
- [Ask Betsy](https://www.lovetospa.com/ask-betsy): One-on-one personalized spa coaching with Betsy Leahy via Telegram for customized wellness guidance.
- [The Spa Journey](https://www.lovetospa.com/transformational-spa-journey): Bespoke transformational coaching aligned with energy and astrology for deep personal wellness work.
- [Art of Spa Living](https://www.lovetospa.com/art-of-spa-living): Spa lifestyle course and wellness education program teaching the philosophy and practice of spa living.

## About & Community

- [Meet Betsy Leahy](https://www.lovetospa.com/about-me): About Betsy Leahy: award-winning wellness travel coach and spa expert specializing in transformational spa journeys.
